message.jaymoskingdoms.bandit_camp.clear: The leader of the %s has fallen to %s! The bandits scatter.
message.jaymoskingdoms.bandit_camp.thank: The roads are safer for it: every kingdom and village thinks better of you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.smuggler_den.clea: The boss of the %s has fallen to %s! The smugglers scatter.
message.jaymoskingdoms.smuggler_den.than: One less smugglers' den: every kingdom and village thinks better of you.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.illager_sites.monk.0: Peace on your road, traveller. The well is sweet, and the bread is shared.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.illager_sites.monk.1: The pillagers held these walls once. We pray in them now.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.illager_sites.monk.2: Rest a while. Nobody here will ask what brought you.
Welcome. We keep the hours here, and the door open to anyone who comes in peace.
Our order took this place when the illagers left it. Stone forgets who laid it.
Bring no blade inside the cloister, and you are our guest.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.illager_sites.herbal: Mind the beds, I've just planted them. Feverfew, mostly.
If you're hurt, come to me before you go to a priest.
Everything that grows here is good for something.
Sit. Let me see that. There: it'll close clean.
You've been bleeding on my floor. Hold still a moment.
Chew this, don't swallow. You'll mend by nightfall.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.illager_sites.reclus: I carried a banner once. Now I carry water. It's the better job.
You've the look of someone who's seen a war. Sit, if you like. Don't tell me about it.
Twenty years in the levy. I came out here to hear nothing at all.
We built this house together. I keep it as they liked it.
Not many come this way. I don't mind the company, for a while.
The town was too loud after. Out here I can still hear them.
My realm put me out. I've stopped arguing with it.
Don't say you saw me, if you're going back that way.
A lord's word sent me here. My own keeps me here.
If anyone asks, I've always lived here.
I walked away from a battle once. I'd do it again.
You're not a recruiter, are you? Good.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.illager_sites.smuggl: Someone's going through our goods. Get them.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.154: Old pillager holds stand empty until the land round them opens up. Then bandits, pirates, smugglers, greenskins or illagers move in, and the chests are worth opening.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.155: Smugglers let you be unless you strike one or go through their goods. Their fence deals in Shash, forged papers and sealed bundles.
